diagnosis.what_happened: Headers lacked a preceding blank line in the text and were spaced too tightly to the preceding body paragraphs in the generated Word document.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Failing to enforce an explicit blank line before headings degrades readability, violates Iranian university thesis formatting manuals, and creates cramped visual layout.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Every heading (#, ##, ###, ####) must be preceded by an explicit blank line in Markdown and an unequivocal blank line space (empty line/paragraph or 24pt space_before) in OpenXML Word output.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Standard institutional thesis formatting mandates visual separation between preceding content and subsequent section headings to establish clear hierarchical demarcations.

desired_behavior: Ensure an explicit blank line precedes every heading across Markdown source and Word DOCX deliverables.
generalization: Universally enforce a preceding blank line before all headings across all chapters and academic documents.

evidence.threshold_value: Exactly 1 blank line before every header
